fireside.speaker: Emma
fireside.text: "237 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Wilhelm
fireside.text: "372 wood. We need 500. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Katarina
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Leo
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: James
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Nathan
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Min-young
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Ursula
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Maya speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kira.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 1 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Declan's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)

🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
